title: B-Roll Shot Spec
description: What the orchestrator's LLM emits per shot beat. The B-roll layer consumes one of these and returns one (asset, .meta.json) pair.

shot_id.description: Immutable join key — propagates through asset_path, meta, attribution, logs.

intent.description: Human-language description of what the shot should show. The verifier checks candidates against this.

kind.description: Drives the decision matrix. See broll/lib/decision.py:DECISION_TABLE.

duration_seconds.description: Target on-screen length. The wrapper may trim downloaded clips to duration + buffer.

queries.description: Pre-seeded keyword queries from the orchestrator. May be empty — keyword_generator will fill in.

stock_first.description: Orchestrator hint. The decision layer may override for kinds where AI is forbidden or required.

tone.description: Atmospheric guidance for AI prompt assembly (e.g. 'calm, observational').

negative_intent.description: Optional: what the shot must NOT contain. Used by verify + AI negative prompt.

format_hint.description: Optional explicit resolution / aspect hint forwarded to AI generation.

reference_urls.description: User-supplied reference links (YouTube, news embeds, file:// paths). When present, reference ingest runs before the stock cascade.
